_note: Leave salary at retirement for an employee who is not a Central or State Government employee: deducted up to the least of four limbs (D-106; rulebook RET-LEAVE-OTHER-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.19(1) Table Sl. 14 (p.44), "(a) the cash equivalent of the leave salary in respect of the period of earned leave at his credit at the time of his retirement … (entitlement of earned leave shall not exceed thirty days for every year of actual service); (b) amount 'A', where,— A = 10 × B; B = average monthly salary for the ten months immediately preceding his retirement …; (c) amount as the Central Government may, by notification, specify …; and (d) actual payment received." TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10AA)(ii) (thc.nic.in pp.72–73), "in respect of so much of the period of earned leave at his credit … as does not exceed ten months, calculated on the basis of the average salary drawn by the employee during the period of ten months immediately preceding his retirement … subject to such limit as the Central Government may, by notification … specify"; Explanation: entitlement "shall not exceed thirty days for every year of actual service". The two years' first limbs differ: TY 2026-27's is "the cash equivalent of the leave salary" — what the employer pays for the leave at credit; TY 2025-26 has no such limb, the 1961 clause valuing the leave at credit "on the basis of the average salary", so its version names the limb "leave at credit valued at the ten-month average salary" and the employer's figure must be so valued (and each year's "salary" is its own: Sch. IV Pt A r.2(h) for TY 2025-26, s.19(2)(b) for TY 2026-27). Limb (a)'s figure and (b)'s average are the employer's (LeaveAtRetirement): neither Act says how many days make a month, and the ten months end on the retirement day. "Ten months' average salary" is 1000% of the monthly average, stating the Act's ten as data. The limit: S.O. 2276(E), 24-5-2023, Rs. 25,00,000 from 1-4-2023 (Gazette CG-DL-E-24052023-246047, p.2), carried into the 2025 Act by s.536(2)(j); an earlier retirement is refused. Every regime.

limbs.name: leave at credit valued at the ten-month average salary
